responsibility: This definition module declares a simple stack abstraction for arbitrary ADDRESS values. It provides creation, destruction, push/pop/replace, depth queries, and indexed access to stack contents, giving parser passes and support code a reusable LIFO container without exposing that it is implemented on top of Indexing.
same_name_distinction: This .def file is the abstract interface for the mcStack stem, exporting an opaque stack type and its operations; unlike mcStack.mod, it hides the Indexing-based representation and all push/pop implementation details.
